info.title: PyJackett API
info.summary: Search many torrent trackers through one Torznab API.
info.description:
PyJackett turns many torrent trackers into one search API. Point Sonarr,
Radarr, Lidarr, Readarr or Prowlarr at the **Torznab** endpoint, or use the
JSON endpoints from your own code.

## Authentication

Every endpoint takes the server's API key in the `apikey` query parameter
(`passkey` is accepted as an alias). The key is shown in the dashboard
header. The discovery endpoints also accept a dashboard session cookie.

## Indexers

An *indexer* is one tracker, or a group of them. `all` searches every
configured tracker; `tag:<name>`, `type:<name>`, `lang:<name>` and
`status:<healthy|failing|unknown>` search a filtered group. Only configured
indexers can be searched; `GET /indexers` lists what exists.

## Errors

* **Torznab** endpoints answer errors as an XML `<error code description>`
  document, usually with HTTP 200, as the protocol requires. Check the body.
* **JSON** search endpoints answer 401 (bad key, empty body) or 404 (unknown
  or unconfigured indexer, plain text).
* **Discovery** endpoints answer JSON: `{"detail": "Unauthorized"}` with 401
  or `{"result": "error", "error": "..."}` with 404.
* A tracker that fails or times out never fails a manual search: its entry
  in `indexers` carries `status: "error"` and the reason.

## Versioning

This is version 1 of the API, served under `/api/v1`. Every search and
discovery operation is also served, unchanged, under Jackett's `/api/v2.0`
prefix, so Sonarr, Radarr, Prowlarr and other Jackett clients work with only
a new base URL. Those operations are listed under the `jackett` tag, with
operation ids ending in `Jackett`.
Results are cached for a few minutes; pass `cache=false` to Torznab to
bypass the cache.

get.description: The endpoint for Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr, Readarr and Prowlarr. Add `/api` to the path if your client insists on it. Releases link to this server (`/dl/...`), which fetches the torrent for the client, so tracker credentials never leave it.

parameters.name: indexer_id

schema.description: Indexer id, e.g. `torrentscsv`, or `all` / a filter such as `tag:anime` to search several trackers at once.
schema.title: Indexer Id

parameters.description: Indexer id, e.g. `torrentscsv`, or `all` / a filter such as `tag:anime` to search several trackers at once.

parameters.name: t
parameters.description: The function. `caps` describes the indexer, `indexers` lists the members of a meta indexer, the rest search. Defaults to `search`.

parameters.name: cat
parameters.description: Comma separated Torznab category ids; see `GET /categories`.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Skip this many releases; only for trackers with pagination.

parameters.name: extended
parameters.description: `1` adds the attributes of the extended Torznab feed.

parameters.name: cache
parameters.description: `false` skips the results cache for this request.

parameters.name: imdbid
parameters.description: IMDb id, with or without the `tt` prefix.

parameters.name: configured
parameters.description: With `t=indexers` on a meta indexer: only list configured (`true`) or unconfigured (`false`) members.

200.description: The results feed, the capabilities document or, for protocol errors such as a bad key, an `<error>` document.

application/rss+xml.example:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<rss version="2.0" xmlns:torznab="http://torznab.com/schemas/2015/feed">
  <channel>
    <title>Fake Tracker</title>
    <item>
      <title>Big Movie 2020 1080p</title>
      <guid>https://tracker.example/details/1</guid>
      <size>1610612736</size>
      <link>http://pyjackett:9117/dl/faketracker/?path=...&file=Big+Movie</link>
      <pubDate>Fri, 01 Mar 2024 12:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <torznab:attr name="seeders" value="42"/>
      <torznab:attr name="peers" value="49"/>
      <torznab:attr name="category" value="2040"/>
    </item>
  </channel>
</rss>

caps.value:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<caps>
  <server title="Fake Tracker"/>
  <limits default="100" max="100"/>
  <searching>
    <search available="yes" supportedParams="q"/>
    <tv-search available="yes" supportedParams="q,season,ep"/>
  </searching>
  <categories>
    <category id="2000" name="Movies"/>
  </categories>
</caps>

error.value:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<error code="100" description="Invalid API Key"/>

429.description: The tracker asked to slow down (XML `<error>`).

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before trying again.

get.summary: Search and get every tracker's results as JSON
get.description: Searches the selected trackers in parallel and answers once they all finished or after 30 seconds, whichever comes first. Trackers that failed or timed out are reported in `indexers`; the others still deliver their `results`. Use `/stream` to receive trackers as they finish.

parameters.description: Text to search for. A trailing `S01E02`, `E02` or `S01` selects a season and episode; `tt1234567` alone is an IMDb lookup.

parameters.description: Comma separated indexer ids to search; default is all members.
